title: Pin launch trace completeness in real policy and configuration fixtures
outcome: Pin launch trace completeness in real policy and configuration fixtures
acceptance: Real policy/config success paths assert trace completeness/count/kind/ended, so removing begin wiring fails.

completion.summary: Real Windows policy and configuration supervisors now require complete launch traces with exact total/kind counts and END records; missing begin wiring is detected. Flood capture asserts payload bytes and active reporting names its capture limit. Landed, installed, full gate and independent reviews/evaluations passed; all five live stores ready.
